plain: The act of carrying out or following a plan, law or duty

webster.text: A following; prosecution, process or continued exertion to reach or accomplish something; as in pursuance of the main design.

example.quote: And the courts of law, which will be constituted by it, are not only to decide upon the constitution and the laws made in pursuance of it, but by officers subordinate to them to execute all their decisions.
example.cite: Brutus XI, New York Journal, Jan. 31, 1788
